front.intro: This East End bungalow was updated from the foundation up, so the big-ticket work is already done. The foundation was reworked, leveled and braced, and the house has new wiring and a new breaker box, new plumbing and a new roof. New Hardi Plank siding and a board-and-batten gable face the street. Inside, the Kitchen and both baths are all new. Out back, a covered garage and a long patio sit in a fully fenced yard. A new driveway runs down the side of the lot to reach them.
front.outro: Telephone Road is close, with Coral Sword and Greenway Coffee under half a mile away. EaDo is minutes from the door. Downtown Houston is 3.5 miles away. The Esplanade on Navigation and Original Ninfa's are about 2 miles out. Daikin Park is about 2.7 miles for Astros game days.

back.title: A Covered Garage, Patio and Fenced Yard
back.planNote: The plan reads from the street at left to the yard at right. The Living Room, Dining area and Kitchen run in a line behind the front door, and the Breakfast Nook sits at the back with its own door to the deck. A short hall off the Dining area leads to the Primary, Bedroom 3 and the rear baths. The Primary is at the back of the house, away from the street. The covered garage and the patio sit side by side at the right edge, open to the fenced yard. Approximate and not to scale; the buyer verifies room sizes.

photos.name: Covered Garage
photos.text: Heavy wood posts and a solid roof cover the garage, with a plank back wall and a concrete floor. The house has three-phase power, a real plus for a workshop or heavy equipment. Park under it, work in it or set it up as an outdoor lounge.

photos.name: Backyard and Deck
photos.text: A mature shade tree stands in the fenced yard, with a small deck and steps down from the Breakfast Nook door. The patio (8'11" x 25'11") runs the full length of the covered garage. A new driveway runs down the side to reach both.

big.name: Covered Garage
big.text: Heavy wood posts and a solid roof cover the garage, with a plank back wall and a concrete floor. The patio (8'11" x 25'11") runs alongside, so the whole space reads as one long covered room. Park under it, work in it or set it up as an outdoor lounge. The house has three-phase power, a real plus for a workshop or heavy equipment. A new driveway runs down the side of the house to reach it. The fence goes all the way around the yard. The wiring out here is all new, like the rest of the house.

photosNoplan.name: Patio and Deck
photosNoplan.text: The patio runs the full length of the covered garage, with a small deck and steps from the Breakfast Nook door. A large mature shade tree stands in the yard. The Breakfast Nook door is a short walk from the patio, across the deck.

photosNoplan.name: Backyard
photosNoplan.text: Open ground beyond the deck leaves room for a garden or a seating area. A white wood deck with steps leads out from the Breakfast Nook door to the yard. A side drive reaches the covered garage for easy parking. The yard is fully fenced.

back.footnote: Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Room dimensions are approximate, per the floor plan. Living area per HCAD.

top.title: From the Front Door to the Back Deck

bands.head: Living Room + Front Entry
bands.text: The Craftsman-style front door, with its divided-light window, opens straight into the Living Room from the covered porch. A tall double-pane window faces the street, and a long clerestory window set high on the wall brings in daylight and keeps the room private. Wood-look floors run from here to the Kitchen with no thresholds, and carpet stays in the bedrooms. The room is large enough for a full sofa and a pair of chairs facing the window.

bands.head: Kitchen + Breakfast Bar
bands.text: All new, the Kitchen is laid out in an L with a peninsula that opens to the Dining area and the Living Room. Stone-look counters and a full-height stone-look backsplash run behind a stainless range and chimney hood. Two pendant lights hang over the peninsula, with room for barstools on one side and prep space on the other. The pantry is just off the Kitchen, with the Breakfast Nook behind it.

bands.head: Dining Area + Breakfast Nook
bands.text: The Dining area sits between the Kitchen peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms, under a sputnik-style light fixture. It is large enough for a full table, with the Living Room a few steps away. The Breakfast Nook is tucked behind the Kitchen, lit by windows on two walls, with a door straight out to the backyard deck. The counter wraps right up to the Nook, so breakfast is a step from the stove.

bottom.title: A Private Primary at the Back of the House

bands.head: Primary Bedroom + Primary Bath
bands.text: The Primary Bedroom has the only vaulted ceiling in the house, with an exposed painted beam overhead. A double-door closet is across the room, and the doorway to the bath is on the same wall. The all new bath has double sinks on a dark navy vanity under an LED backlit mirror that spans its width. There is room for a king bed, nightstands and a dresser, with space to walk around the bed.

bands.head: Bedroom 2 + Bedroom 3
bands.text: Bedroom 2 is the larger of the two secondary bedrooms, at the front corner of the house, lit by windows on two walls. Bedroom 3 has a reach-in closet beside the door, which leaves the window wall open for a desk or a bed. Both rooms open to a short hall with wood-look floors that leads to the hall bath and back to the Kitchen. Carpet runs wall to wall in each. Either one can double as an office.

bands.head: Primary Closet + Hall Bath
bands.text: Double doors open to the Primary Closet, with a shelving tower down the center and hanging rods on both sides. More shelves above hold bins or luggage, and the built-ins stay with the house. Bedrooms 2 and 3 share the hall bath, which also serves guests. It has a tub with a full-height marble-look tile surround, marble-look tile on the floor and a window over the tub. Deep built-in linen shelves sit just outside the door in the hall.

a.text: Follow the new concrete walk to a stained wood door under the covered stoop. A wide cased opening joins the living room to the dining area and the kitchen, so you can see straight through the front of the house. The primary sits at the back under a vaulted ceiling. Out back, the covered garage and the patio share one fenced yard.

rows.head: Open Plan and Back Yard
rows.text: The front door opens straight into the living room, with the kitchen and its barstools beyond. Out back, white steps lead down from the deck to the yard.

rows.head: Kitchen and Nook
rows.text: Marble-look counters climb the wall behind a stainless range and hood. The nook beside it has windows on two walls and a beam overhead.

rows.head: Front Gable and Back Yard
rows.text: Board and batten covers the front gable. Behind the house, the garage and the patio sit side by side, with white steps down from the deck.

rows.head: Kitchen and Nook
rows.text: Marble-look counters climb the wall behind a stainless range and hood. The nook beside it has windows on two walls and a beam overhead.

Out back, a covered garage and a covered patio share the fenced yard. The East End puts you minutes from Downtown and the Navigation Esplanade.

back.a: A long clerestory window sits high on the wall, with a tall front window below it.
Marble-look counters run up the wall behind a stainless range and hood.
A vaulted ceiling with an exposed beam, and windows on two walls.
Double sinks on a dark navy vanity, beside a rain shower with a handheld.
The covered patio runs alongside the garage, open to the whole fenced yard.

jl.about9: The nook has windows on two walls, and the peninsula has room for barstools. A tub with floor-to-ceiling tile fills the hall bath. Bedroom 3 keeps its closet on the hall side. Hardi Plank siding wraps the outside.
jl.about11: The breakfast nook has windows on two walls, and the peninsula has room for barstools. The hall bath has a tub with floor-to-ceiling tile and a pebble tile niche. Bedroom 3 keeps its closet on the hall side and leaves the window wall open for a desk. Hardi Plank siding wraps the house, and a fence closes in the yard.

js.front9: I listed this home with photos of every room, a floor plan and a printed brochure in buyers' hands at the first showing. I read each offer with the sellers line by line, and I checked in every week until closing. On closing day I was at the table when the keys changed hands.
js.front11: I listed this home with photos of every room, a floor plan and a printed brochure waiting at the first showing. I read each offer with the sellers line by line, kept the inspection and the appraisal on schedule, and called them every week with what I was hearing. On closing day I was at the table when the keys changed hands.
js.cta: Call today to schedule a private home consultation.
js.meet9: We walk your house together, room by room, and I bring the recent sales from your street. You leave with a plan for photos, showings and a list date, and we talk through timing and what to expect. Bring your questions. It takes about an hour, on a weekday evening or a Saturday morning.
js.meet11: We walk your house together, room by room, and I bring the recent sales from your street and the streets around it. You leave with a written plan for photos, showings and a list date, and we talk through timing and what to expect, and you can bring every question you have. It takes about an hour, at your kitchen table on a weekday evening or over coffee near you on a Saturday morning.
